products_and_commercial_policy.finding: All eight product names, basic prices, image URLs, image hashes and exact SKU links match original fwith evidence. Four product cards per article are specified. The copy preserves mixed fresh/artificial materials, possible seasonal/regional variation, address-dependent extra cost, no separate collection, production/elapsed-delivery/address/refusal restrictions, defect/damage/wrong-item refund grounds, unavailable fulfilment/stock full refund and the separate post-shipment minus-shipping clause. It does not invent a universal cancellation cutoff, guaranteed time, free delivery, stock, affiliation or physical specification.

facility_facts.finding: Five funeral addresses/identities and three wedding addresses are consistent with previously inspected primary originals. Han River hospital/footer distinction is correct, held Dangsan FAQ is absent, and no live family or room names are copied. JK/Withus source note preserves static-only status. Withus 10F classification needs the narrower wording in C1.

information_completeness.finding: Both guides cover the known occasion, budget and product selection, destination identity, ribbon options, one order route, total-price uncertainty, suitable timing consultation, material variation, no collection and policy exceptions. No essential purchase-information gap was found within verified service scope. The wedding depositor-name FAQ is source-supported; the funeral no-flowers FAQ answers a suitability question not repeated in the main body. More FAQ or longer prose is not required.

warmth_empathy_smalltalk.finding: The funeral opening is restrained and supportive; the wedding opening uses a brief congratulations context and invites discussion without inventing memories, emotions, experience or popularity. Provider voice is present and help is limited to product/ribbon/order consultation. Repetition of hall/room instructions needs removal so courtesy is more than repeated 말씀해 주세요/상담해 드립니다 endings.

customer_homework_and_tone.finding: No sustained fear-based warnings or customer incompetence narrative. Local helper paragraphs nevertheless repeat the same input task, and explaining how to replace placeholder names is unnecessary. Do not remove actual delivery/receipt/refund constraints while fixing this.

substantive_cross_region_duplication.finding: Compared all final Gangseo four, Guro three and Geumcheon one body/FAQ sets. Shared product tiers, total budget, ribbon wording, change/refund and no-collection answers recur because they are the same business truth. Local destination content is genuinely different, including five distinct funeral facilities and the funeral-annex address, plus JK building and Partyum/Withus names/floor labels. These are sufficient for the frozen two grouped intents; unrelated office/performance pages remain absent. Repeated consultation instructions should not be treated as additional unique value. Exact-string checks are supplementary, never the reason for approval.

common_text.finding: Home title/H1/intro/cards, navigation, directory cards, price/material/collection notices, product CTA/alt/caption, phone/footer, FAQ heading, approved banner alt/AI caption and 404 wording were actually read. Common copy is brief and provider-led. Product photos and AI atmosphere banners remain distinct. Two-card noindex/no-banner intent matches plan. Source heading needs C3.
